mirrordrive.notes:
# MirrorDrive v0.14.0

### Features
- Rename detection now runs by default in two-way sync (previously gated behind an unrelated setting, so it never actually activated for most users — renames just created duplicates on Drive instead)
- Custom ignore patterns now support standard wildcard matching, e.g. `screenshot_*.png`

### Bug fixes
- Fixed a security issue where a specially-named item in a shared Drive folder could cause files to be written or deleted outside the mapped sync folder
- Release builds are now signed with a dedicated release key instead of a shared debug key
- Fixed a case where an interrupted download could corrupt a file and then overwrite the good copy on Drive on the next sync
- Fixed sync sometimes treating two different Drive files as the same file when they happened to share a name
- Rename detection no longer risks reverting a rename made directly on Drive
- Downloads now stream to disk instead of loading the whole file into memory, preventing out-of-memory risk on large files
- Fixed a rare case where editing a file mid-upload could leave the sync index out of sync with what's actually on Drive
- Google Docs/Sheets/Slides files in a synced folder are now skipped instead of failing every sync run
- Drive folder scanning now runs in parallel instead of one subfolder at a time, speeding up sync on deeply nested folders

Note: because release builds are now signed with a new key, this update cannot install automatically over an existing MirrorDrive install — it needs a manual reinstall (uninstall the old app, then install this APK) once. Every release after this one will update normally.

Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings
